'''Speeder Sales''' was a business on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]], where an advertisement for the establishment was put up at [[Orondia station]]. The advertisement was [[Color/Legends|green]] and black and featured the name of the business next to a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]].<ref name="Friends" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Signage at the fueling station includes: Eat at Koe's, Bounty Emporium: Always Open, Bounty Never Sleeps; Security Services; Speeder Sales; The Pilot's Lounge (Live Band Every Night); Craft Repair and Maintenance; Repair Rack Droid Services; Orondia Tours; and Meteor Cafe|StarWars.com Trivia Gallery for "Friends and Enemies"|<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-trivia-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref>}}
Craft Repair and Maintenance was first mentioned in an advertisement at [[Orondia station]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Friends and Enemies]]."<ref name="Friends" />
